advices.diagnosis: The class has a high LCOM4 (2) indicating low cohesion among its methods, and it references two distinct project-internal classes (DCC = 2). The methods are simple (WMC = 4) and all attributes are private (DAM = 1.0). The design suggests that responsibilities are mixed: customer description logic and mail sending logic are embedded in the view class, leading to feature envy and coupling to external services.

suggestions.title: Extract helper classes for customer description and mail summary

advices.risk_notes: Splitting responsibilities increases the number of classes and may introduce wiring complexity if dependency injection is not used. If the application is small, the added indirection might outweigh the cohesion benefits. Ensure that the new helper classes are not duplicated elsewhere, otherwise the overall DCC could remain unchanged.
